title: PHP request cleanup memory corruption (PHP2Shell)
summary: Critical PHP core vulnerability. A project declaration alone cannot establish whether the deployed web runtime is affected.
recommendation: Update the actual web-serving PHP runtime to a vendor-fixed release and verify the running workers. For older branches, consult the OS/vendor advisory for backported fixes; do not infer vulnerability solely from upstream version numbers.

title: PHP session upload-progress configuration advisory
summary: The PHP advisory recommends disabling session upload progress until the next regular bugfix release. This check only reports configuration evidence; it does not prove effective web-runtime configuration.
recommendation: Verify session.upload_progress.enabled is disabled in configuration that takes effect before request parsing, then restart every relevant worker. Confirm the latest official advisory for release status.
